audit.whatIsWrong: win[6]/phases[6].side said K'Sante wins the 2+ item stage while the 'late' prose on the same page says 'This is where she edges you'. The packet chart also has Sejuani for that row.
audit.why: Sejuani's late value is Glacial Prison, a 1300-range AoE stun on 120/105/90s, against K'Sante's single-target R. Nothing in either kit gives K'Sante a two-item edge over her.
audit.corrected: Row 6 flipped to Sejuani in both layers, rating 5/10 -> 4/10. Rows 3 and 5 left as they are; the prose supports them and the win rate (52.16 over 416 games) is close to even.

audit.why: Lvl 3 (full Q-W), Lvl 4-5 (lane-control peak), Lvl 6 (All Out vs her R), 2+ items (her utility scaling) are the right four timings.
audit.corrected: Timings kept; the mechanics named inside them corrected.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three separate errors. (a) 'she has no dash to escape your charge' — Arctic Assault (Q) is a 650-range charge on 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s. (b) Arctic Assault was labelled her E; Permafrost is E and Arctic Assault is Q. (c) 'her W percent-HP' damage is invented — Riot's text for Winter's Wrath is damage, slow and Frost stacks, no max-health component, and the kit carries no percentHealth flag.
audit.why: Permafrost (E) is 1.5s cooldown but only fires on a target at maximum Frost stacks, and Frost comes from Winter's Wrath (9/8/7/6/5s). So the punish window is 'before she has stacked you', not a stun cooldown. Fury of the North also grants resists and slow immunity out of combat, which blunts your Q slow on the first hit.
audit.corrected: Q/E naming fixed everywhere, the Arctic Assault escape and its 18s rank-1 cooldown stated, percent-HP claims replaced with the real Frost-stack mechanic and Frost Armor's resists.

audit.whatIsWrong: Advice keyed to 'her E stun cooldown', which is 1.5s and never the limiter.
audit.why: The real window is Winter's Wrath (down 9s at rank 1) and Arctic Assault (down 18s at rank 1).
audit.corrected: Trades re-keyed to Frost stacks and Arctic Assault's cooldown.

edits.before: Both of you are slow immobile tanks at Level 1 with no kill threat — last-hit and watch for her Frost Armor passive proc.
edits.after: Both of you are tanks at Level 1 with no kill threat — Frost Armor makes her immune to your Q slow until you damage it off.

edits.after: Full Q-W online: you W a committed Sejuani and Q3 pull her in — bait Arctic Assault first, it is down 18s.

edits.before: Your lane-control peak as a tank — you trade around her E stun and own a reset she lacks via E Footwork.
edits.after: Your lane-control peak — Permafrost only stuns at max Frost stacks, so trade before her W has stacked you.

edits.before: Your first tank item is durable but she trades evenly with percent-HP W, so neither side spikes clearly here.
edits.after: Your first tank item is durable but Winter's Wrath re-stacks Frost every 7s, so neither side spikes clearly here.

edits.before: Her W percent-HP and permafrost passive ignore your armor stacking while her R out-utilities your single-target peel in fights.
edits.after: Frost Armor's free resists and her 1300-range Glacial Prison out-scale you: she brings AoE lockdown where your R peels one target.

edits.before: Your full Q-W combo is online — W into a committed Sejuani and Q3 knock-up for the only clean burst in this slow tank mirror.
edits.after: Your full Q-W combo is online — W into a committed Sejuani and Q3 pull for the only clean burst in this slow tank mirror.

edits.before: Your lane-control peak: bank small leads trading around her E-stun cooldown while she has no reset to punish you back.
edits.after: Your lane-control peak: bank leads while Permafrost has no Frost stacks to fire on and she has no reset to punish you.

edits.before: Her percent-HP W and permafrost passive ignore your armor stacking — she trades evenly into your bulk and out-utilities you in skirmishes.
edits.after: Fury of the North's resists and her 1300-range Glacial Prison out-utility you — she brings AoE lockdown where your R only peels one target.

edits.before: Two slow tanks poking — neither of you dies at Level 1, so just farm and respect that her Frost Armor passive procs a slow-and-CC if she lands enough hits. Once you hit Level 3 you have the only real combo: W into her when she commits to a trade, then Q3 to knock her up and pull her in. She has no dash to escape your W charge, so a clean W stun against her own minions or wall is your best early lead. Do not waste W on her E Arctic Assault dash — bait it first.
edits.after: Two slow tanks poking — neither of you dies at Level 1, so just farm and respect Frost Armor: out of combat it hands her resists and slow immunity, so your Q slow does nothing until you break it. Once you hit Level 3 you have the only real combo: W into her when she commits to a trade, then Q3 to pull her in. Her escape is Arctic Assault (Q), down 18 seconds at rank 1, so a clean W stun into a wall is your best early lead. Do not waste W on that dash — bait it first.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your peak in this lane: you trade around her E stun cooldown, and unlike her you have E Footwork as a reset to disengage and reposition. Bank plates and small CS leads here because neither of you can outright kill the other. At 6, All Out gives you a duelist 1v1, but it strips your tankiness right as her R Glacial Prison can flip you mid-dash — only ult-commit when her R is down, or you trade your bulk for nothing.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your peak: Permafrost only stuns once Winter's Wrath has stacked Frost on you, and unlike her you have E Footwork as a reset to disengage and reposition. Bank plates and small CS leads here because neither of you can outright kill the other. At 6, All Out gives you a duelist 1v1, but it strips your tankiness right as her R Glacial Prison can flip you mid-dash — only ult-commit when her R is down, or you trade your bulk for nothing.

edits.before: This is where she edges you. Her W deals percent-max-HP and her permafrost passive layers slows regardless of how much armor you stack, so your defensive scaling does less against her than against a normal bruiser. In teamfights her R Glacial Prison is a guaranteed AOE flip while your R only peels one target — she brings more lockdown to a 5v5. Close the game on your mid-game side-lane pressure; do not bet on out-scaling a fellow tank whose damage ignores your bulk.
edits.after: This is where she edges you. Winter's Wrath comes back every 5 seconds at rank 5 and Fury of the North keeps handing her free resists, so your armor stacking buys less against her than against a normal bruiser. In teamfights her R Glacial Prison is a 1300-range AOE flip while your R only peels one target — she brings more lockdown to a 5v5. Close the game on your mid-game side-lane pressure; do not bet on out-scaling a fellow tank.
